description_blocks.text: Introduction

This kit includes a Multi-Function Core Board and a Time-lapse Trigger Expansion Board. Just install the core board onto the expansion board, connect it to your printer with the Bambu Bus cable, and follow the wiki to quickly pair your camera. The core board comes preloaded with the required firmware, so you can start time-lapse photography right away.
Bluetooth Compatibility List
* The compatibility list is for reference only. Please verify compatibility with other brands/models yourself.
Frequently Asked Questions
1. Can't pair with "BBL_SHUTTER" device?
Please delete the paired "BBL_SHUTTER" device information from your phone and try pairing again.
2. Can't the camera find the "BBL_SHUTTER" device?

If another device occupies the Bluetooth port, it may cause the Bluetooth connection to not be retrieved. Please disconnect the time-lapse photography kit from the printer for 2 seconds and then reconnect.
3. Can't establish a Bluetooth connection with the paired time-lapse photography kit after restarting the camera?
Press and hold the multifunction button for 2 seconds to try to reconnect the previously paired device. If you still can't connect, delete the camera pairing information and pair it again.
4. Both the camera and the time-lapse photography kit have been powered off. The kit cannot be automatically connected after the camera is turned on?
Press and hold the multifunction button for 2 seconds to reconnect the previously paired device.
5. Frame dropping phenomenon occurs in the synthesized time-lapse photography video?
iOS device may miss files during photo transfer, please reconnect your phone to your computer to ensure that all photos are copied.
6. How many shooting devices can be controlled at the same time?
Supports up to 4 devices: connect 1 smartphone and 1 camera via Bluetooth, 1 camera via shutter cable, and 1 camera via mechanical servo.
7. Why is it recommended to use the official cable to connect the kit with the printer?
This can avoid the time-lapse photography function not working due to invalid connection between devices to the greatest extent.
Important Notices

For security and stability, the CyberBrick Multi-Function Core Board only supports firmware updates through official tools. Flashing with third-party tools is not supported and may cause irreversible damage, which is not covered by warranty. Please use only official tools for any firmware operations. Thank you for your understanding!
If you have purchased the time-lapse photography shield and are using it together with the Cyberbrick core board, please refer to the wiki to flash the time-lapse photography firmware.

The company is not responsible for any device damage, malfunction, fire, or other losses resulting from failure to comply with the above requirements. Please strictly follow the safety instructions for this product.

Introduction

Just install the core board onto the expansion board, connect it to your printer with the Bambu Bus cable, and follow the wiki to quickly pair your camera. The core board comes preloaded with the required firmware, so you can start time-lapse photography right away.

Product Specification

Item Number Component Description
1 4-Pin interface Connect the printer 4pin interface
2 6-Pin interface Connect to AMS 6pin interface
3 2.5mm shutter cable interface Connect the camera shutter cable and control the camera shutter
4 Multi-function buttons & Indicator lights Connection, Debugging, Light language
5 Servo connection Connect to the servo to simulate button operation and control shutter release
6 Multi-Function Core Board access Plug-in Multi-Function Core Board
7 Orientation marks Ensure proper installation alignment

Complete Step-by-Step Assembly & Setup

Bluetooth Compatibility List

*The compatibility list is for reference only. Please verify compatibility with other brands/models yourself.

Android Requires Android 12 or later
iOS Requires iOS 16 or later
HarmonyOS Requires HarmonyOS 4.2.0 or later
SONY α7C2 / α7M4 / α7R5 / FX30 / α6700
Canon EOS R7 / EOS R6 / EOS R50
Nikon Z30 / Z6II

Press and hold the multifunction button for 2 seconds to reconnect the previously paired device.

6. How many shooting devices can be controlled at the same time?

7. Why is it recommended to use the official cable to connect the kit with the printer?
